audience: marketers and shop owners who send newsletters with Laposta

useCases.title: Count subscribers on each mailing list
useCases.text: The AI lists your mailing lists with the number of active, unsubscribed and cleaned members, so you see how each list is doing.

useCases.title: Compare the results of recent newsletters
useCases.text: The AI reads the campaign reports and sets sent, opened, clicked, bounced and unsubscribed figures side by side for your latest newsletters.

useCases.title: See what one subscriber has done
useCases.text: The AI finds a member by email address and reads the event history: what they opened, clicked, and when they signed up or unsubscribed.

useCases.title: Review a campaign before it goes out
useCases.text: The AI reads the subject, sender, recipients and plain-text content of a campaign, and points out what looks wrong or missing.

useCases.title: Subscribe or unsubscribe people
useCases.text: Give an email address and a list. The AI adds the person, or marks a member as unsubscribed. A double opt-in list sends its confirmation email.

useCases.title: Prepare a newsletter draft and send a test
useCases.text: The AI creates a campaign draft, fills in your HTML and mails a test copy to one address. You send it to the list yourself in Laposta.
